shortBio.en: Oasis's chief writer—and the living proof of the sibling-feud rock trope.
shortBio.zh: Oasis 的主笔——也是「兄弟必反目」摇滚梗的活证据。

whyHub.en: Songwriter hub who outlasts the classic Oasis lineup into a solo continuum.
whyHub.zh: 活过 Oasis 经典阵容、进入独奏连续统的词曲枢纽。

body.en: Read Noel beside Liam as a Person pair: same band, incompatible orbits. Lineup versions of Oasis stay 'classic Britpop peak'; the sibling graph explains why the version ended.
body.zh: 把 Noel 与 Liam 当人物对来读：同一支乐队，不相容的轨道。Oasis 阵容版本仍是「Britpop 巅峰」；兄弟关系图解释版本为何结束。
